name: fission

metadata.description: Fission Labs' private catalogue of agentic skills. Two bundles: fl-design-system (Fission's own design system, end to end — setup plus all 10 component skills) and frontend-common (framework-independent debugging/exploring/knowledge-lookup, plus the gate for framework-specific upstream installs). Deliberately scoped to Fission's own design system only, not a generic multi-brand adapter layer — see README.

plugins.name: fl-design-system
plugins.description: Fission's own design system, end to end — fl-ds-setup scaffolds or installs it, and ten component skills (fl-ds-button, fl-ds-dialog, ...) each check it's installed before using it, installing it on the spot if not. Scoped to Fission's own system only.

plugins.name: frontend-common
plugins.description: Framework-independent frontend skills (debugging, codebase exploration, knowledge lookup) plus the confirmation gate for framework-specific upstream installs (React/Next/Angular/Vue), so a project only ever gets the upstream bundle matching its actual stack.

_comment_upstream: High-level/non-component framework skills (React & Next.js practices, accessibility, framework upgrades, library-version-matched guidance) are NOT built here — they're already published by their maintainers (Vercel, TanStack). See UPSTREAM.md for the install commands, and frontend-common's fe-upstream-setup skill for how a project is gated to only the matching one.
_comment_scope: A prior round of this marketplace also shipped a generic, multi-brand design-system plugin (detect-and-adapt to MUI/Chakra/AntD/a registered brand/plain CSS). It was dropped after a live install on a client's own custom design system produced inconsistent output — the generic detection heuristics weren't reliable enough. Current direction: get Fission's own design system working end to end first, reliably, before attempting to generalize again.
